response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), ranked AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, trans_count, 1.0 * account_sum / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM acct) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, trans_count, share FROM ranked ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Region is district.A3 of the account's own district (account.district_id), not the client's district, since the request says to join accounts to their districts.

Only PRIJEM (added) and VYDAJ (subtracted) rows contribute to the account sum; VYBER and other types contribute 0, as the request says to leave other types out. The transaction count includes all types.
Inner joins drop transactions whose account or account's district has no match.

The share is computed as a REAL (1.0 *) because amount is INTEGER and would otherwise be integer-divided; NULLIF makes a region with a zero total yield a NULL share, which sorts last. The SQL targets SQLite, where the window function and NULL ordering work as written.
Ties in share have no specified tiebreak, so which rows appear at the top-10 boundary when shares tie is not determined by the request.
